wireRules: Default Gson excludes null object/map members; null array elements remain. PixelStreamUtility writes task metadata values directly, retaining explicit null there.
Frames and task references use PixelStreamUtility envelopes rather than reflective Java class fields.
Query struct runtime class determines Gson adapter. ConfigSelectQueryStruct is reflective; inherited named qs can retain update/raw/file subtypes.
NounMetadataAdapter query operands differ from nested Pixel output envelopes: pixelType/class/value/opType versus output/operationType.
FunctionQueryFilterAdapter currently cannot produce a valid single JSON value; failure is not assigned an invented successful response shape.
Frame header isPrim/isDerived values are Boolean when stored as RDF boolean literals, or string coalesce defaults; RawRDF4JSelectWrapper preserves that distinction.

backendFindings.finding: write emits a root string FUNCTION followed by an object; a direct default-Gson probe produced "FUNCTION"{}, invalid JSON.
backendFindings.impact: Function filters can invalidate query JSON serialization. QueryFilterWireOutput describes the valid SIMPLE/AND/OR variants.

backendFindings.finding: JsonWriter.value receives a Java char and selects its numeric overload; comma serializes as 44.
backendFindings.impact: The output delimiter type is number, matching the actual serializer.

backendFindings.finding: getMetamodel relation query selects two columns but later reads row[2].
backendFindings.impact: Exception is caught; edges can be empty despite frame relationships. Envelope remains stable.

validation.method: Direct constructor/default-Gson probes against compiled backend; no external services or frame mutations.
observed: UpdateQueryStruct default envelope with updateValues array
limitations: R/Python analytics require configured runtimes and data and were traced statically rather than executed.
Source types describe expected-success output; transport/runtime error typing remains unchanged.

Default QueryFunctionSelector has no function and throws during serialization; valid functions are typed from QueryFunctionSelectorAdapter and concrete selector constructors, not the invalid default instance.
frontendChecks: Focused Biome check --write on both owned files passed.
pnpm --filter @semoss/sdk exec tsc --noEmit -p . passed with the first output overlay.
